title: Simple List After Directions

illustrates.quote: A list is not preceded by a blank line: ... c. When it follows directions. (See Formats, §10, Exercise Material.)

blocks.text: Write the principal parts for each verb. Use your dictionary if needed.
blocks.features: Two-line direction/instruction text directly above the list, no blank line beneath it in print.
Four one-word verb items, one per line, plain roman lowercase.

print.printFeatures: Boxed illustration; two-line direction sentence immediately above four plain lowercase words, no rule line between them.

braille.notes: Blank line precedes the direction text (line 1) per ordinary paragraph spacing; the two-line direction (indented 4 blank cells, i.e. cell-5 style) is immediately followed by the list with no blank line between, per 8.3.3.c; 'be' is transcribed as the one-cell whole-word contraction '2' (dots 2,3) and 'go' as the one-cell whole-word contraction 'g', per standard braille contractions, not letter-for-letter spelling; a blank line follows the list.

resolution: braille.lines byte-identical between A and B; only prose fields differed — A’s kept. Directions paragraph modeled as an ordinary paragraph block (Emboss has no "directions" concept — F-37); illustrates.quote kept as A’s (stem + clause c, matching the source’s own multi-clause layout).
